findings.details: All nine pages show consistent body measure, margins and centered footers. The D20-D28 statements, proof paragraphs, displays and two small tables stay within the text block, with no visible overlap, clipping, missing-glyph boxes or detached equation labels.

The D29-D32 sequence, numbered hypotheses, cusp-unit table and displayed group actions are clean at contact-sheet resolution. The D32 heading and its route-obstruction qualification fit the page; equations and labels remain separated from prose and page numbers.

D32 ends cleanly before the unresolved-obligations subsection; the transition into Part E has clear hierarchy and spacing. The E1-E14 sampled statements and formulas have consistent geometry, legible citation styling and no visible clipping or overlap.

All nine sampled Part F pages have consistent margins and typography. Long proof paragraphs, subgroup formulas, displayed arrows, subsection transitions and claim headings remain contained; page numbers are unobstructed.

All nine sampled Part F pages show clean section and proof hierarchy, contained displays and citations, and consistent text measures. No visible glyph corruption, margin overflow, text collision or footer interference.

Full-resolution inspection of D32 opening: the long subsection title and Proved route obstruction status fit cleanly. The symplectic-isomorphism cover, equations D32.1-D32.4, italic scope qualification and proof start are sharp and separated. No clipped math, collision or displaced equation number.

Full-resolution inspection of the geometric and arithmetic cusp calculations: matrices, product formula D32.6, right-action displays D32.7-D32.9 and their labels are legible and contained. Paragraph headings and citations have clean spacing; the final line and footer do not collide.

Full-resolution inspection of the unit lattice and explicit GL2 tower: the injection, two-line divisor display, Tate unipotents and Frobenius conjugation matrices fit without clipping. The proof-ending square is correctly placed, and the Manin-Drinfeld paragraph begins with adequate space.

Full-resolution inspection of the end of D32: the bounded-index paragraph and exact-checks block are legible; code and audit paths stay within the text measure. The unresolved-obligations heading and D.U1-D.U3 statements have clear spacing and unobstructed footer.

Full-resolution inspection confirms the D.U4 conclusion and transition into Part E are clean. The long Part E and subsection5.1 headings fit the page. E1, its Artin-Schreier display and the proof formulas have no overlap, clipping or broken glyphs.

limitations: The five contact sheets were actually viewed at their displayed resolution, covering the exact45 physical pages listed. Physical pages228-232 were additionally inspected individually at full resolution, including the entire D32 section and the Part E transition. This is not a claim to have read every glyph on every contact-sheet page or to have visually reviewed unassigned pages. No mathematical source, PDF or rendered image was modified.
